<?php

[$n, $k] = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));

$m = min($n, 13);

$factorial = array_fill(0, $m + 1, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= $m; $i++) {
    $factorial[$i] = $factorial[$i - 1] * $i;
}

if ($k > $factorial[$m]) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$start = $n - $m;
$available = [];
for ($i = $start + 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $available[] = $i;
}

$permutation = [];
$rank = $k - 1;

for ($remaining = $m; $remaining >= 1; $remaining--) {
    $blockSize = $factorial[$remaining - 1];
    $index = intdiv($rank, $blockSize);
    $rank %= $blockSize;

    $removed = array_splice($available, $index, 1);
    $permutation[] = $removed[0];
}

$isLucky = static function (int $number): bool {
    while ($number > 0) {
        $digit = $number % 10;
        if ($digit !== 4 && $digit !== 7) {
            return false;
        }
        $number = intdiv($number, 10);
    }
    return true;
};

$luckyNumbers = [];
$generateLucky = function (int $number) use (&$generateLucky, &$luckyNumbers, $n): void {
    if ($number > 0) {
        $luckyNumbers[] = $number;
    }

    $next = $number * 10 + 4;
    if ($next <= $n) {
        $generateLucky($next);
    }

    $next = $number * 10 + 7;
    if ($next <= $n) {
        $generateLucky($next);
    }
};

$generateLucky(0);

$answer = 0;

foreach ($luckyNumbers as $position) {
    if ($position <= $start) {
        $answer++;
    } else {
        $value = $permutation[$position - $start - 1];
        if ($isLucky($value)) {
            $answer++;
        }
    }
}

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;

<?php

[$n, $k] = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));

$fact = array_fill(0, 14, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= 13; $i++) {
    $fact[$i] = $fact[$i - 1] * $i;
}

if ($n <= 13 && $k > $fact[$n]) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$isLucky = static function (int $x): bool {
    if ($x <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    while ($x > 0) {
        $digit = $x % 10;
        if ($digit !== 4 && $digit !== 7) {
            return false;
        }
        $x = intdiv($x, 10);
    }
    return true;
};

$length = min($n, 13);
$start = $n - $length + 1;
$prefixEnd = $start - 1;
$answer = 0;

$queue = [4, 7];
$head = 0;

while ($head < count($queue)) {
    $x = $queue[$head++];
    if ($x > $prefixEnd) {
        continue;
    }

    $answer++;

    $next4 = $x * 10 + 4;
    $next7 = $x * 10 + 7;

    if ($next4 <= $prefixEnd) {
        $queue[] = $next4;
    }
    if ($next7 <= $prefixEnd) {
        $queue[] = $next7;
    }
}

$available = range($start, $n);
$rank = $k - 1;

for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
    $remaining = $length - $i;
    $blockSize = $fact[$remaining - 1];
    $index = intdiv($rank, $blockSize);
    $rank %= $blockSize;

    $value = $available[$index];
    array_splice($available, $index, 1);

    $position = $start + $i;
    if ($isLucky($position) && $isLucky($value)) {
        $answer++;
    }
}

echo $answer . "\n";

<?php

$input = preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN)));
$n = (int)$input[0];
$k = (int)$input[1];

$factorial = array_fill(0, 14, 1);
for ($i = 1; $i <= 13; $i++) {
    $factorial[$i] = $factorial[$i - 1] * $i;
}

$length = min($n, 13);

if ($factorial[$length] < $k) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$start = $n - $length + 1;
$available = range($start, $n);
$permutation = [];
$rank = $k - 1;

for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
    $remaining = $length - $i;
    $blockSize = $factorial[$remaining - 1];
    $index = intdiv($rank, $blockSize);
    $rank %= $blockSize;

    $permutation[] = $available[$index];
    array_splice($available, $index, 1);
}

$isLucky = static function (int $number): bool {
    foreach (str_split((string)$number) as $digit) {
        if ($digit !== '4' && $digit !== '7') {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
};

$answer = 0;
$queue = [4, 7];

for ($head = 0; $head < count($queue); $head++) {
    $position = $queue[$head];

    if ($position > $n) {
        continue;
    }

    if ($position < $start) {
        $answer++;
    } else {
        $value = $permutation[$position - $start];
        if ($isLucky($value)) {
            $answer++;
        }
    }

    $next = $position * 10 + 4;
    if ($next <= $n) {
        $queue[] = $next;
    }

    $next = $position * 10 + 7;
    if ($next <= $n) {
        $queue[] = $next;
    }
}

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;

<?php

[$n, $k] = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));

$length = min($n, 13);

$factorial = [1];
for ($i = 1; $i <= $length; $i++) {
    $factorial[$i] = $factorial[$i - 1] * $i;
}

if ($factorial[$length] < $k) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$start = $n - $length + 1;
$available = range($start, $n);
$permutation = [];
$rank = $k - 1;

for ($remaining = $length; $remaining >= 1; $remaining--) {
    $blockSize = $factorial[$remaining - 1];
    $index = intdiv($rank, $blockSize);
    $rank %= $blockSize;

    $removed = array_splice($available, $index, 1);
    $permutation[] = $removed[0];
}

$lucky = [];
$stack = [4, 7];

while ($stack) {
    $number = array_pop($stack);

    if ($number > $n) {
        continue;
    }

    $lucky[$number] = true;
    $stack[] = $number * 10 + 4;
    $stack[] = $number * 10 + 7;
}

$answer = 0;
$fixedPrefixEnd = $start - 1;

foreach ($lucky as $number => $_) {
    if ($number <= $fixedPrefixEnd) {
        $answer++;
    }
}

for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
    $position = $start + $i;
    if (isset($lucky[$position]) && isset($lucky[$permutation[$i]])) {
        $answer++;
    }
}

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;

<?php

[$n, $k] = array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(stream_get_contents(STDIN))));

$fact = [1];
$length = 0;

while ($length < $n && $fact[$length] < $k) {
    $length++;
    $fact[$length] = $fact[$length - 1] * $length;
}

if ($fact[$length] < $k) {
    echo "-1\n";
    exit;
}

$prefixEnd = $n - $length;
$answer = 0;

$countLucky = function (int $value) use (&$countLucky, &$answer, $prefixEnd): void {
    if ($value > $prefixEnd) {
        return;
    }
    if ($value > 0) {
        $answer++;
    }
    $countLucky($value * 10 + 4);
    $countLucky($value * 10 + 7);
};

$countLucky(0);

$isLucky = function (int $value): bool {
    if ($value <= 0) {
        return false;
    }
    while ($value > 0) {
        $digit = $value % 10;
        if ($digit !== 4 && $digit !== 7) {
            return false;
        }
        $value = intdiv($value, 10);
    }
    return true;
};

$available = [];
for ($i = $prefixEnd + 1; $i <= $n; $i++) {
    $available[] = $i;
}

$rank = $k - 1;

for ($offset = 0; $offset < $length; $offset++) {
    $remaining = $length - $offset;
    $blockSize = $fact[$remaining - 1];
    $index = intdiv($rank, $blockSize);
    $rank %= $blockSize;

    $value = array_splice($available, $index, 1)[0];
    $position = $prefixEnd + $offset + 1;

    if ($isLucky($position) && $isLucky($value)) {
        $answer++;
    }
}

echo $answer . "\n";

Description: Petya loves lucky numbers. Everybody knows that lucky numbers are positive integers whose decimal representation contains only the lucky digits 4 and 7. Output Specification: If the k-th permutation of numbers from 1 to n does not exist, print the single number "-1" (without the quotes). Otherwise, print the answer to the problem: the number of such indexes i, that i and ai are both lucky numbers.

7 4
Sample Output:
1

4 7

1
